entries.report.title: Record-keeping report: this Goose agent's imported tool-call log
entries.report.summary: What the holder's book shows about the tool-call log of its agent host, as the holder imported it, from the passes the holder answered with: whether it was imported, whether any pass declared a gap, and whether any row arrived late or changed. The auditor ran these three terms over the rows the holder answered with. Each row was proven to be in the holder's log at a signed checkpoint; the values on it are the holder's own word, and no proof shows that no row was left out. The book detects a missing or late record, it does not prevent one.
entries.group.record_keeping.title: Did the agent's tool-call log reach the holder's book without a gap?
entries.row.record_keeping.passes_present.label: The host's tool-call log was imported into the book
entries.row.record_keeping.passes_present.detail: At least one import pass of the agent host's own tool-call log is recorded in the holder's book.
entries.row.record_keeping.passes_present.not_ev: The holder's answer holds no import pass, so this report can't say whether the host's log was imported.
entries.row.record_keeping.no_declared_gaps.labe: No gap declared in the imported log
entries.row.record_keeping.no_declared_gaps.deta: No import pass the holder answered with declared a gap: no stretch of the host's log was unreadable, expired before a pass read it, or a cursor range the host never used.
entries.row.record_keeping.no_declared_gaps.not_: An import pass in the holder's answer does not carry its list of gaps, or the answer names a record it does not type, so this report can't say whether a gap was declared.
entries.row.record_keeping.no_late_or_changed_ro: No late or changed rows in the imported log

No import pass the holder answered with listed a row that arrived late, a re-read row whose content changed after it was first digested, or an id that appears twice in one pass with different contents.

An import pass in the holder's answer does not carry its lists of late and refused rows, or the answer names a record it does not type, so this report can't say whether any row arrived late or changed.
